subject: beodeul_town_wall

criteriaNotes.same_game: Wall face is a different art set from the houses beside it. Measured at 1x: the north wall face (x80-120,y48-78) uses only 7 colours, all pure neutral greys (R=G=B within 3: 89/91/88, 146/148/145, 168/170/167, 196/198/195, 211/213/210). The stone house next to it (x245-315,y245-270) uses 19 colours and the half-timber house 52, all warm or purple-shifted. The wall outline/mortar dark is a mid neutral grey (89,91,88), but the Beodeul outline is purple-black (43,32,63). That makes the wall read much lighter, cooler and flatter than the houses (3x: the whole south wall y=880-1000 is a bright pale band, brighter than any house). Bricks are large, clean 8x4px rectangles with 1-2 speckles, while the houses have dense 2-3px texture, so it is too clean. The tower roofs (3x x=245-330,y=725-805 and x=1060-1150) use saturated orange/gold (219,133,55) with a near-white yellow highlight (255,242,165). Beodeul house roofs are deep brick red (134,55,54)/(88,40,64) with no yellow, so the turret roofs read as a different, brighter set. The pink walkway brick (158,141,131)/(188,170,160) is closer to the palette and is fine.
criteriaNotes.view_34: Mostly correct. E-W walls show a walkway top band above their face: the north wall shows its inner face and the south wall its outer face, with the parapet on the south (outer) edge sitting on the face top (3x y=880-895). The W/E walls show only their tops, with merlons on the outer edge. The gatehouse shows a two-row crenellated top plane (kit-wall_ring 4x y=130-190). Stairs are drawn flush inside the face (3x x=195-235,y=140-235), which is the RM2k cliff-stair convention and acceptable. Weaknesses that do not fail this criterion on their own: the towers are flush with the wall face (same baseline, 3x tower x=240-335 bottom y=1000 = wall bottom) so they do not project; and the pyramid roof is drawn as a flat elevation triangle with no top-plane cue (kit-tower 4x).
criteriaNotes.seamless_joins: Straight runs, corners, T-junctions, tower and gatehouse joins are clean. The end caps are broken. West gap upper cap (1x x=17-31,y=120-128; 3x ~x=60-95,y=362-385): a light merlon block juts out past the right (inner) dark outline onto the grass, and the top-to-face transition has no dark edge line. West gap lower cap (1x x=17-31,y=192-200; 3x ~x=50-95,y=575-595): a stray merlon stub sits on the inner side even though the W wall parapet is outer-side only, and the top outline is missing on the left half. The same artifact appears at the spur end in parts-scene-3x (~x=390-425,y=312-332), at kit-wall_parts-4x (~x=520-560,y=415-445) and at the end cap (~x=400-445,y=1440-1465). The north road in the test map dead-ends against plain wall (3x x=625-720,y=235) instead of reaching the north gate (x=965-1050). This is layout, not kit, but it hurts the demo.
criteriaNotes.gate_readable: At 1x the south gate (x=205-240,y=290-335) is a dark arch with a floor strip and the road continuing below it, so it reads as an open passage. The portcullis teeth at the top (4x kit y=110-130) could read as half-lowered, but the dark void wins. The north gate is a clear brown double door, so it reads as closed. The west gap is a clean cobble band between two caps and reads as an opening.
criteriaNotes.readability_1x: Reads as a crenellated stone town wall with towers and gatehouses around a village, not a fence or a building. The face is 2 cells, the same as the one-storey house walls, and the towers are about 4.5 cells, so the scale is plausible. Its brightness dominates the scene, which is a same_game issue rather than a readability one.

fixes: Repalette the stone: replace the 5 neutral greys with a warm/purple-shifted ramp taken from Beodeul stone (e.g. sample the stone house/reference wall), lower the overall value by ~15-20% so the wall face is not the brightest thing on screen, and use the Beodeul purple-black (43,32,63)-family outline instead of (89,91,88) for the outer silhouette and the plinth bottom edge.

Add texture density: break each 8x4 brick with 2-3px dithered tone clusters and chipped corners at the density of the stone house wall; vary mortar darkness; reduce brick size or mix half-bricks so the pattern is not a clean repeating grid.
Recolour the tower roofs from the Beodeul house roof ramp (134,55,54)/(144,59,58)/(88,40,64): remove the (255,242,165) yellow and (219,133,55) orange highlights.

Fix the end caps (W gap upper/lower, spur end, kit-wall_parts end caps): keep merlons on the outer edge only, remove the merlon block that overhangs the inner outline, and draw a continuous 1px dark outline around the cap top and a dark edge line between the cap top and its front face.

Make the towers project: drop the tower base 4-8px below the wall plinth line with its own plinth and a cast shadow on the grass, and add a shading split (lit/shadow halves) on the pyramid roof so it reads as a volume, not a flat triangle.
Test map: route the north road to the north gatehouse (or move the gate to x=208-240 at 1x) so the closed gate is part of the demo.
